text: Welcome to the emergency department. I need to understand what is going on with you to help you safely. Can you tell me exactly what symptoms you are experiencing right now, and when they started?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient's roommates report that he has been displaying increasingly aggressive and unusual behavior. They mention that he has been under significant stress due to final exams and has become more reclusive. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pheochromocytoma.
